shadows.name: stat-sheet
shadows.purpose: Single lifted sheet on the reading pane only.

motion.name: ease-out-short
motion.purpose: Filter chevron and resize gutter hover.

components.name: Filter Chip
components.description: Toggle filter or mode; uppercase mono label.
components.css: .ds-chip { font: 600 10px/1 ui-monospace, monospace; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.08em; padding: 6px 9px; border: 1px solid var(--hair, #C5C2B8); border-radius: 2px; background: var(--stone, #E7E5E0); color: var(--dim, #5F594F); cursor: pointer; } .ds-chip:hover { border-color: var(--gilt, #9C7C1C); color: var(--ink, #24211C); } .ds-chip:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--gilt, #9C7C1C); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Filter Chip Selected
components.css: .ds-chip-on { background: var(--ink, #24211C); border-color: var(--ink, #24211C); color: var(--stone-3, #F2F1ED); }

components.name: Primary Action Chip
components.css: .ds-chip-go { font: 600 10px/1 ui-monospace, monospace; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.08em; padding: 6px 9px; border: 1px solid var(--brick, #7B2418); border-radius: 2px; background: var(--brick, #7B2418); color: #FBF6EA; cursor: pointer; } .ds-chip-go:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--gilt, #9C7C1C); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Search Input
components.css: .ds-search { padding: 9px 13px; border-radius: 3px; border: 1px solid var(--hair, #C5C2B8); background: var(--paper, #FFFFFF); color: var(--ink, #24211C); font: 15px/1.2 system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-search:focus { outline: none; border-color: var(--gilt, #9C7C1C); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(156,124,28,.18); }

components.name: Catalog List Item
components.css: .ds-item { padding: 8px 12px 8px 10px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--hair-soft, #D8D5CC); border-left: 3px solid var(--brick, #7B2418); display: flex; align-items: baseline; gap: 10px; cursor: pointer; } .ds-item-nm { flex: 1; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-item-lv { color: var(--faint, #645D51); font: 10.5px/1 ui-monospace, monospace; }

components.name: Rarity Trait
components.css: .ds-trait-rarity { font: 600 10px/1 ui-monospace, monospace; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.08em; padding: 4px 7px; border: 1px solid var(--gilt, #9C7C1C); border-radius: 2px; background: var(--vellum-edge, #E7DBBE); color: var(--ink, #24211C); }

narrative.overview: The interface is a GM's physical table: cool stone chrome holds warm paper stat blocks. D&D 5e reads on vellum serif; Pathfinder 2e on clean white sans.
keyCharacteristics: Two paper stocks per game system
Gilt reserved for borders and focus, not body text
Operate mode: task completion over decoration

rules.name: The Gilt Border Rule
rules.body: Gilt may outline, focus, or underline; it must not carry readable text smaller than large display type.

rules.name: The Spine Rule
rules.body: List items and combatant cards mark game system with a 3px left border.

rules.name: The Role Scale Rule
rules.body: New font sizes must be added to DESIGN.md before use in CSS.

rules.name: The Flat Chrome Rule
rules.body: Sidebars and lists have no drop shadow; only the stat block sheet lifts.

dos: Do assign --sysink, --sheet, and --cell on #pane per game system
Do use aria-pressed on chip toggles
donts: Don't use gilt as foreground on vellum, paper, or stone
Don't nest focusable controls inside listbox options
